LESSON: PRINTING

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 2.1: Printing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Printing. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate own and others painted work objects

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate own and others painted work objects
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate own and others painted work objects. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Printing.
2. Explain Printing to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.
